title: Deal with People Like Animals
passage:
Everyone has something in common. We all have to deal with difficult people. It's never easy. If you take a few tips from the animal kingdom, though, it can be a little bit easier.

When you face a difficult person, think of a big, angry elephant coming toward you. What should you do? Move out of the way, of course. Just let the elephant pass by. Similarly, when negative people are around you, don't try to fight or argue with them.

Difficult people behave like bees. They fly around because they want you to fight with them. Stay calm around them. Be ready for anything they might do.

Sometimes you can't avoid a difficult person. So, be an eagle. Fly high above them. When you see them from far away, you'll understand them better.

Or you can be a hyena. Hyenas laugh at everything. Find the humor in a difficult situation and make a joke. People can't be mad if they're laughing.
